_source.title: 导出制造文件
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口对应私有化部署版本一键导出制造文件功能
_source.remarks.text.1: 将根据前端一键导出制造文件弹窗的配置获取其文件数据
_source.remarks.text.2: 注意：本接口仅私有化部署版本有效，如若在其他版本调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Export the manufacture data
remarks.text.0: This API corresponds to the one-click manufacture data export function of the private deployment edition
remarks.text.1: It will obtain the file data according to the configuration of the one-click manufacture data export popup on the front end
remarks.text.2: Note: This API is only valid for the private deployment edition. Calling it in other editions will always `throw Error`
